name: comp-325
title: Sign Up Dialog
description: A trigger opens a compact dark dialog with a ring icon, a welcome line, three labelled fields, a white Sign up button, an Or divider, Continue with Google and a terms note.
use: You want a compact sign-up form to open over the page without leaving its context.
avoid: The form has no submit logic, so it needs wiring to a real auth service before use.
a11y: Every field has a bound label, but the password cannot be revealed and there is no error or success feedback. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, an outlined Sign up button. Open, a narrow dark rounded dialog: a small outlined ring icon above a bold Sign up coss.com title and grey subtitle, three stacked outlined fields, a full-width white Sign up button, a thin Or divider, an outlined Continue with Google button and a tiny terms line.
behaves: The trigger fades the dialog in over a dimmed page, and Escape or the X closes it. Typing fills the fields, but Sign up and Continue with Google have no action attached.
customise: All labels, placeholders and copy are fixed in the file, and the component accepts no props.
weight: light: One dialog with three plain inputs; no animation beyond the opening fade.
demo: Placeholders Matt Welsh, hi@yourcompany.com and Enter your password; a filled Maya Chen example appears later.
issues: Sign up and Continue with Google have no handlers, so neither does anything.
The password field has no show or hide control.
polishWhy: Balanced compact form with clear hierarchy; inert submit and no password toggle.
